text: 调研与图表模式（Research & Charts）是面向临床与管线研究的 DSH 代理预设，通过 agent-preset 选择器注册。它随附证据研究、靶点与适应症尽调、临床图表技能，可整理可追溯结论并生成注册库分布、管线和时间线等图表，且提供配色、布局、对比度与渲染检查。注册表检索会请求 ClinicalTrials.gov；已读代码未显示 API key 配置。

Research & Charts is a DSH preset for clinical and pipeline research. Its skills produce traceable findings and figures such as trial distributions and timelines, with chart checks for layout and contrast. It queries ClinicalTrials.gov; no API key setting appears in the inspected code.
想把临床试验和管线调研做成可追溯的图表。
需要比较某个靶点或适应症的研究格局，并保留每条结论的来源。
I need auditable charts for a clinical trial landscape, with the underlying registry records traceable.
调研与图表模式的功能「证据追踪研究」：按请求加载研究或尽调技能，组织带来源定位与置信度等级的事实，并要求记录检索范围与结果。通过选择对应研究模式触发，面向竞争格局、靶点、临床试验或适应症问题。
调研与图表模式的功能「临床景观图表」：读取研究项目中的临床试验数据并生成注册库分布等图表，质量流程依次检查配色、布局、像素对比度和渲染产物。选择图表技能后按其流程准备项目数据并运行图表门。
调研与图表模式的临床注册表检索会向 ClinicalTrials.gov API 请求研究记录；已读客户端代码未显示 API key 配置。

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 调研与图表模式（Research & Charts）：> DeepSeek Harness 插件：注册 `research-charts-mode` 代理预设——带证据分级与来源留痕的临床、管线调研，并把结论做成通过了质检门的可交付图表。

这个模式解决的是**调研结论不可核实**的问题。它不产出"读起来像那么回事"的报告，而是产出：每条事实绑定来源与定位、每条结论带置信度分级、每个"没查到"都声明了可达范围，以及每张图都经过了可复现的质量门。

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 这个模式做什么：三份技能按固定顺序咬合：

| 阶段 | 技能 | 回答的问题 |
|---|---|---|
| 上游 | `high-confidence-research` | 这条信息可不可信？ |
| 中游 | `target-indication-diligence` | 这个方向值不值得做、先做哪个？ |
| 下游 | `clinical-landscape-charts` | 怎么把结论画成可审计的图？ |

覆盖的工作：竞争格局、靶点、专利/FTO、管线、临床试验、公司、适应症调研；多轴评分与 Go/No-Go；以及管线泳道、注册库分布、覆盖矩阵、里程碑时间线、森林图等图表。

**不覆盖**：单篇文献精读（用 `deep-paper-reading`）、系统综述式检索（用 `scientific-evidence-en-mode`）、AI 生成插图（用 `image-generation-mode`）。

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 方式零：一键使用（最简）：在 Preset Square 打开中文详情页，点安装即可，不需要打包、也不需要改配置文件：

<https://dshdesktop.com/preset/zh/p/research-charts-mode-8738ff>

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 方式一：作为 DSH 插件安装（推荐）：```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode@latest
```

从本地目录安装：

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode
```

重启 DSH Desktop。新开一个会话，在模式选择器里选择「调研与图表模式」。

text:
dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 方式二：直接放置 preset：把 `presets/research-charts-mode/` 整个目录复制到：

```
${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/research-charts-mode/
```

（Windows 上 `DSH_HOME` 通常为 `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness`。）

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 方式三：`.dshpreset` 交换包：```sh
node scripts/build-dshpreset.mjs
```

产物在 `dist/`，可在 DSH Desktop 中导入。

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 技能清单：三份技能**随本插件分发**，因此装好即用，不依赖目标机器上装过什么。完整清单（含按需加载的外部技能）见 `presets/research-charts-mode/SKILLS.md`。

自带的三个：`high-confidence-research`、`target-indication-diligence`、`clinical-landscape-charts`，均为 MIT。

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 环境要求：- **Python 3.11+**，图表流水线需要 `matplotlib`、`numpy`、`pillow`、`pypdf`
- **中文字体**（Microsoft YaHei / SimHei / Noto Sans CJK SC 之一）——图表样式层在找不到 CJK 字体时**故意报错**，而不是静默输出豆腐块
- **网络**：仅注册库检索与网页取证步骤需要；审计与渲染全部离线、确定性

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 项目目录契约：调研产物按四段式落地，来源留痕不可省：

```
01_数据/    数据集 CSV + DATA_DICTIONARY.md（字段含义与取值口径）
02_图表/    PNG + SVG + PDF + .export.json（溯源清单）
03_报告/    报告正文与导出件
04_来源/    原始抓取载荷、检索日志、分类与调色板审计、_webcache/

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 校验：```sh
python3 scripts/check-composition.py    # 组合形状：清单、patch 键、preset 与技能元数据
node scripts/build-dshpreset.mjs        # 打包 .dshpreset 并校验归档布局
```

两者都只验证**形状**。真正证明 harness 能组合这份组合的，是安装后启动一次会话。

图表技能自带自检，可对任意符合 schema 的项目数据跑全部图型与质检门：

```sh
python presets/research-charts-mode/skills/clinical-landscape-charts/selftest_recipes.py --srcdir <project>
```
dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · 许可：MIT。详见 `LICENSE`。

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Research & Charts mode：> DeepSeek Harness plugin: registers the `research-charts-mode` agent preset — evidence-graded clinical and pipeline research that ends in auditable figures.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Research & Charts mode：This mode exists to fix one failure: research conclusions you cannot check. It does not produce prose that merely reads well. It produces findings where every claim is bound to a source plus a location, every conclusion carries a confidence grade, every "not found" states the scope it was searched within, and every figure has passed a reproducible quality gate.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · What it does：Three skills, chained in a fixed order:

| Stage | Skill | The question it answers |
|---|---|---|
| upstream | `high-confidence-research` | Is this information trustworthy? |
| middle | `target-indication-diligence` | Is this direction worth pursuing, and which indication first? |
| downstream | `clinical-landscape-charts` | How do we turn the conclusion into an auditable figure? |

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · What it does：Coverage: competitive landscape, target, patent/FTO, pipeline, clinical-trial, company, and indication research; multi-axis scoring and Go/No-Go; and figures — pipeline swimlanes, registry distributions, coverage matrices, milestone timelines, forest plots.

**Not covered:** single-paper close reading (`deep-paper-reading`), systematic-review workspaces (`scientific-evidence-en-mode`), AI-generated illustration (`image-generation-mode`).

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · One click from Preset Square：Open the listing and install from there — no packaging, no config editing:

<https://dshdesktop.com/preset/zh/p/research-charts-mode-8738ff>

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · As a DSH plugin (recommended)：```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode@latest
```

From a local checkout:

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile <profile> add file:/absolute/path/to/dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode
```

Restart DSH Desktop, open a new session, and pick "调研与图表模式" (Research & Charts) in the mode picker.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · By placing the preset directly：Copy `presets/research-charts-mode/` into:

```
${DSH_HOME}/.agent-presets/research-charts-mode/
```

On Windows `DSH_HOME` is usually `%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness`.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · As a `.dshpreset` exchange package：```sh
node scripts/build-dshpreset.mjs
```

The artifact lands in `dist/` and can be imported through DSH Desktop.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Bundled skills：All three ship with this plugin, so a fresh install works without depending on what the machine happens to have installed globally. The full manifest, including the external skills this mode loads on demand, is in `presets/research-charts-mode/SKILLS.md`.

`high-confidence-research`, `target-indication-diligence`, and `clinical-landscape-charts` — all MIT.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Requirements：- **Python 3.11+** with `matplotlib`, `numpy`, `pillow`, `pypdf` for the chart pipeline
- **A CJK font** (Microsoft YaHei / SimHei / Noto Sans CJK SC) — the chart style layer *fails loudly* when it cannot find one, rather than silently emitting tofu boxes
- **Network** only for registry retrieval and web evidence; all audits and rendering are offline and deterministic

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Project layout contract：```
01_数据/    datasets (CSV) + DATA_DICTIONARY.md
02_图表/    PNG + SVG + PDF + .export.json provenance manifests
03_报告/    report text and exports
04_来源/    raw payloads, query logs, classification and palette audits, _webcache/

Keeping the raw trail under `04_来源/` is not optional: a conclusion without its payload is not verifiable.

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Checks：```sh
python3 scripts/check-composition.py    # bundle manifest, patch keys, preset and skill metadata
node scripts/build-dshpreset.mjs        # build the .dshpreset and verify the archive layout
```

Both verify **shape only**. The only proof that the harness composes this composition is starting a session on it after install.

The chart skill ships a self-test that runs every figure recipe plus the full quality gate against any project that follows the schema:

dsh-plugin-research-charts-mode README · Checks：```sh
python presets/research-charts-mode/skills/clinical-landscape-charts/selftest_recipes.py --srcdir <project>
```
